description: Creates or updates contact center forecasting settings: planning groups, forecast events and capacity plans, each matched by itemId then name. A record that is updated takes every member of the entry, so a member left out goes back to its default. Planning groups are imported first, so events and plans can name one of the same step.

items.description: A planning group: queues forecast and staffed together.

itemId.description: The planning group's id. When it matches a stored planning group, that planning group is updated; otherwise the planning group is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

queueNames.description: The queues it forecasts, by name; added to queueIds. Queues named must exist.

queueIds.description: The queues it forecasts, by id.

channel.description: The channel it forecasts; null for every channel of its queues.

teamName.description: The team that staffs it, by name. Wins over teamId.

teamId.description: The team that staffs it, by id.

serviceLevelPercent.description: The share of contacts to answer within serviceLevelSeconds, in percent; null to plan by average speed of answer. Defaults to 80.

serviceLevelSeconds.description: The service level time, in seconds. Defaults to 20.

averageSpeedOfAnswerSeconds.description: The average speed of answer to plan for, in seconds, when there is no service level.

maxOccupancyPercent.description: The highest share of time agents should be busy, in percent. Defaults to 85.

concurrency.description: How many contacts an agent handles at once. Defaults to 1.

patienceSeconds.description: How long contacts wait before they give up, in seconds, to plan for abandons.

shrinkagePercent.description: The share of paid time agents are not available, in percent. Defaults to 30.

historyWeeks.description: How many weeks of history the forecast reads. Defaults to 8.

PlanningGroups.description: The planning groups to create or update.

items.description: A forecast event: days whose volume differs from the usual.

itemId.description: The forecast event's id. When it matches a stored forecast event, that forecast event is updated; otherwise the forecast event is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

volumeMultiplier.description: How the usual volume is multiplied on those days, such as 0 for a closure or 1.5 for a promotion. Defaults to 1.

recursYearly.description: Whether the event comes back on the same dates every year.

planningGroupNames.description: The planning groups it affects, by name; added to planningGroupIds. Empty for every planning group.

planningGroupIds.description: The planning groups it affects, by id.

ForecastEvents.description: The forecast events to create or update.

itemId.description: The capacity plan's id. When it matches a stored capacity plan, that capacity plan is updated; otherwise the capacity plan is matched by name, and a new one keeps this id.

planningGroupName.description: The planning group it plans for, by name. Wins over planningGroupId.

planningGroupId.description: The planning group it plans for, by id.

startDate.description: The first week of the plan; moved back to its Monday.

weeks.description: How many weeks the plan covers. Defaults to 26.

weeklyWorkloadHours.description: The weekly workload to plan for, in hours; null to use the planning group's forecast.

growthPercentPerYear.description: How much the workload grows a year, in percent.

hoursPerFte.description: The weekly hours of one full-time agent. Defaults to 37.5.

attritionPercentPerMonth.description: The share of agents who leave each month, in percent. Defaults to 2.

trainingWeeks.description: The weeks of training before they take contacts. Defaults to 4.

rampWeeks.description: The weeks until they are fully productive. Defaults to 4.

hiringClasses.description: The planned classes of new hires.

CapacityPlans.description: The capacity plans to create or update.
